verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions lets users write GitHub Actions-compatible YAML workflows and reuse existing Actions, which is the event-driven automation the story asks for. Webhooks and the API add event-based custom workflows and integrations with chat tools and external CI such as Drone, Jenkins and Woodpecker. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the supported event triggers and rule/condition syntax, and independent hands-on corroboration of Gitea Actions itself (community reports cover only external CI like Drone).
